title: Functions
instructions: Answer all questions. For fill‑in‑the‑blank and short‑answer, use one word, letter, or number only.

questions.prompt: A relation is a function if each input corresponds to:
hints: Think about the definition of a function.
No input can have multiple outputs.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A function assigns exactly one output to each input.

questions.prompt: The Vertical Line Test helps determine if a graph is a function: if any vertical line crosses the graph more than once, the graph is ___ a function.
hints: More than one intersection means one $ x $ has multiple $ y $.

questions.prompt: Is the relation $ \{ (2,5), (3,7), (4,9) \} $ a function? (yes or no)
Which equation does NOT represent $ y $ as a function of $ x $?
hints: Solve for $ y $ and check for $ \pm $.
For $ x = y^2 + 2 $, solving gives $ y = \pm\sqrt{x-2} $.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: $ x = y^2 + 2 $ does not represent $ y $ as a function of $ x $ (it gives two y-values).

questions.prompt: What does $ f(2) $ represent in function notation?
options: The value of the function at input 2
hints: It is the output when $ x = 2 $.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: $ f(2) $ is the value of the function at input 2.

questions.prompt: For the function $ f(x) = \sqrt{x+3} $, the domain is all $ x $ such that $ x \ge $ ___.
Evaluate the piecewise function at $ x = 0 $: $ f(x) = \begin{cases} x+5, & x < 0 \\ x^2, & x \ge 0 \end{cases} $. (number only)
Which of the following is NOT a valid way to represent a function?
hints: A single number doesn't define a relationship.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A single number cannot represent a function; functions require input-output relationships.

questions.prompt: What value of $ x $ must be excluded from the domain of $ f(x) = \frac{5}{x-2} $? (number only)
Does the set $ \{ (0,3), (1,5), (2,7), (3,9) \} $ represent a function? (yes or no)
hints: No repeated inputs with different outputs.

questions.prompt: The range of a function is:
options: The set of all input values
The set of all output values
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The range is the set of all output values.

questions.prompt: For a function defined by $ f(x) = |x| $, the domain is all ___ numbers.
hints: Absolute value is defined for any number.
